title: Northern lights lake
prompt_en: 16:9 time-lapse style. Green and purple aurora ripple across a starry sky above a still mountain lake, reflected in the water. Static camera, silhouetted pines, cold night atmosphere.
prompt_zh: 16:9 延时摄影风格。绿色和紫色极光在星空中波动，倒映在平静的高山湖面上。固定机位，松树剪影，寒冷夜晚的氛围。
why_it_works: A static camera with sky motion and reflection is a reliable way to show natural phenomena.
